checks.title: shared visual learning roles are exact and non-navigational
contract defines the ten shared fallback and accessibility families
resolution preserves registered specialist ownership and rejects extension inference

families.annotated-illustration: An image, formula surface or media frame with source-grounded labels and a non-image description.
families.relationship-diagram: Nodes, edges, boundaries or traceability links with explicit semantics and a structured text or table fallback.
families.step-sequence: An ordered reasoning or construction path whose steps have stable identity and observable transitions.
families.state-comparison: Two or more states compared by named dimensions, including partial or inconclusive outcomes when the domain is not binary.
families.trace-timeline: An ordered execution, dialogue, transaction, protocol or lifecycle trace with keyboard-readable events.
families.plot-or-chart: A quantitative display with units, scale, series meaning and accessible underlying data.
families.media-overlay: Audio, video, handwriting or image media synchronized with transcript, captions, annotations or timing state.
families.artifact-view: A versioned learner or source artifact preview that preserves provenance and does not silently copy private local bytes.
families.interactive-model: A deterministic parameterized model with initial state, controls, observable outputs, reset and reproducibility metadata.
families.specialist-widget: A registered subject-engine tool used when a generic family cannot preserve the domain interaction.

fallbackOrder: deterministic static state or artifact snapshot
evidence.resolutionRule: Resolve lessonType, then a registered representationKind, then its family and specialist capability; never infer a renderer from an arbitrary file extension alone.
evidence.profileUsageRule: A type profile is an allowed typed vocabulary and compatibility target; an individual lesson instantiates only visuals justified by its objectives and block policy and never all profile kinds by default.
evidence.noGenericReplacementRule: A fallback preserves learning meaning but does not claim feature parity with a missing formula, dialogue, code, query, diagram, simulation or research tool.
